items.title: At least 106 people are killed by mudslides and flooding in the Recife metropolitan area, Pernambuco, Brazil.
At least 126 people are dead, and 97 missing, after mudslides and floods caused by heavy rain in Sri Lanka. Over 100,000 people have been displaced.
Turkey claims that its artillery fire together with U.S. air strikes killed more than 104 ISIL militants after rockets fired from northern Syria killed several people in the Turkish town of Kilis.
The death toll from the Indian heat wave rises to over 1,400 with over 1000 dead in Andhra Pradesh state alone.
Terrorists attacked two major mosques simultaneously belonging to the Ahmadiyya Muslim community in Lahore, Pakistan killing nearly 100 Ahmadis. See:May 2010 attacks on Ahmadi mosques in Lahore
